description: fr disamb-examples replay on inline rules (marker handling, input/output forms, untouched, bad forms)

args.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules lang="fr">
<rule id="EX_OK" name="EX_OK"><pattern><token postag="D .*" postag_regexp="yes"/><marker><token postag="N .*" postag_regexp="yes"/></marker></pattern><disambig postag="N m s"/><example type="ambiguous" inputform="chat[chat/N m s]" outputform="chat[chat/N m s]">Le <marker>chat</marker> x</example><example type="untouched">Les enfants jouent dans le grand jardin.</example><example type="ambiguous" inputform="a[a]" outputform="b[b]">Le chat mange la souris.</example><example type="ambiguous" inputform="a[a]" outputform="b[b]"><marker>Le</marker> chat mange la souris.</example><example type="untouched"> </example></rule>
<rule id="EX_ADD" name="EX_ADD"><pattern><token postag="N .*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="add"><wd lemma="ADDED" pos="XADD"/></disambig><example type="untouched">Elle a vu un homme avec des amis.</example><example type="ambiguous" inputform="chat[x]" outputform="chat[y]">Le <marker>chat</marker></example></rule>
<rule id="EX_IMM" name="EX_IMM"><pattern><token postag="D .*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="N .*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="immunize"/><example type="untouched">Le chat mange la souris.</example><example type="untouched">Zz.</example></rule>
<rule id="EX_BAD_FORM" name="EX_BAD_FORM"><pattern><token postag="N .*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig postag="N m s"/><example type="ambiguous" inputform="" outputform="x"><marker>Elle</marker></example><example type="ambiguous" inputform="[" outputform="]"><marker>Elle</marker></example></rule>
</rules>
